mechanisms.name: slip of paired 1/2<110> superpartial dislocations on {001} planes

evidence.quote: a slip of paired 1/2<110> superpartial dislocations on the {0 0 1} planes in addition to the {1 1 1} planes in the γ' precipitates results in flow stress anomalies at 700–800 1C.

evidence.section: 3.4. Fractographic observations on the fracture surfaces at high temperatures
evidence.quote: the coherent γ/γ' microstructure fractures completely along the grain boundaries. ... revealing the dominant fracture mode to be the intergranular cleavage.
a slip of paired 1/2<110> superpartial dislocations on the {0 0 1} planes in addition to the {1 1 1} planes in the γ' precipitates results in flow stress anomalies at 700–800 1C.

evidence.section: 3.4. Fractographic observations on the fracture surfaces at high temperatures
evidence.quote: the anomalous temperature dependence of the tensile ductility corresponds to the fracture mechanism changing from dimple mode at room temperature to the intergranular cleavage mode at high temperatures.
